settings.title: Our Story
settings.description:
Founded in 2019, Fuel Hub began at home in Michelle and James kitchen in Warrington.

Discovering a gap in the meal prep industry for high quality, tasty and convenient meals fit for health, conscious consumers with an understanding of the impact good nutrition has on your body and mind.

James was a professional rugby player constantly travelling, having many injury setbacks, relying heavily on nutrition to aid his recovery. “I know the impact the right food has on your physical and mental wellbeing, and this is paramount to perform at your best – be that in sport, business or day-to-day life”

Michelle has led a highly driven fashion career, travelling around the world as a Head of Buying and founder of her own fashion agency with leading international brands. 

James’s sporting background and vast knowledge of nutrition alongside Michelle’s organisation and management skills complement each other creating a powerful duo.
 
Michelle and James have built a business from the ground up whilst raising two young children. They both have a longstanding love for health and fitness and understand the importance of balancing their daily macros to elevate their everyday performance.

The couple have devoted their lives to their business with the ultimate goal of being the UK’s number one provider of meal prep for sports teams and athletes.

WE’VE PERFECTED MEALS THAT FUEL OUR PERFORMANCE.
NOW WE’RE SHARING THEM.

settings.subtitle: Our mission
settings.title: Fuel your performance
settings.description: Here at Fuel Hub we have big ambitions, our ultimate goal is to become the leading ‘go-to nutrition partner’ for sports teams and athletes in the UK. Our mission is to help empower our Team Fuel Hub community to elevate their everyday performance, whatever that may look like.

settings.subtitle: Sustainability
settings.title: Zero food waste
settings.description:
We have the power to impact change in every aspect of our business operations.

Sustainability isn’t a word we slot into conversation - it sits at the very core of everything we do. Although we are known for fuelling teams, athletes and health enthusiasts alike it takes more than just stamina and performance to keep our brand wheels turning, it’s constantly looking at new ways we can change the game and become leaders in our field.

From minimising food waste, to only using ECO friendly and compostable packing made from sugarcane pulp. 

We prepare your meals in a state-of-the-art kitchen that has been designed to utilise eco-friendly elements to minimise environmental impacts. We operate on a zero-waste model.

To us, sustainability Is passing a portion of that ownership onto our consumers and giving them the opportunity to impact the environment, equality and economy.

settings.subtitle: Our ingredients
settings.title: Quality you can taste
settings.description: At Fuel Hub HQ, we pride ourselves on producing 100% fresh, high-quality meals packed full of hand-selected premium ingredients. With over 40 meals monthly, created and developed by a talented team of expert chefs and nutritionists to deliver high protein, macro balanced meals that pack some seriously powerful flavours. Our meals are created with seasonal presence in mind, with a huge ethos on locally sourced produce where we can, to help reduce our carbon footprint – one step at a time.

settings.heading: Ready to fuel your goals?
settings.text: We’ll provide the food you need to succeed.
